description: A correctly hardened host. Three setuid binaries, all in /usr/bin or /usr/sbin and writable by root alone; /tmp is world-writable and sticky, which is what /tmp is supposed to be; no world-writable files; no device node outside /dev; /tmp, /dev/shm and /home are separate mounts with the options each check requires. Every FILESYS check passes here, which is what makes it the module's fixture-coverage backstop.
